Communication dated May 15, 1972, to the State Clearinghouse from the Division of Applied Ecology of the Environmental Information Center.
<u>Comment</u>: Question was raised regarding the exemption of Indians, Aleuts, and Eskimos from prohibitions against the taking of an endangered species for ritual or religious purpose.
Response: This provision has been removed from HR 4658.
Comment: There was objection to a role for the Department of Commerce in administration of the Act.
Response: See our reply to comments by the Florida State Clearinghouse.
Comment: Questions use of the example of removal of older rams from a herd of bighorn to strengthen the herd.
Response: This example has been omitted from the final Environmental Statement.
